deploy_ray_serve_applications: deploy Ray Serve applications using a YAML config or application list with add, replace, or remove actions
get_app_metadata: get application metadata including endpoints, ports, route prefix, model name, and deployment type for a named app
run_llm_inference: run LLM inference against a deployed app using JSONL input files or a Hugging Face dataset
check_app_status: check the current status and running replica count of a deployed Ray Serve or SGLang application
cleanup_container_app: cleanup dangling containers for a stateful container application by releasing all containers
